dialogues.speaker: Rikas
dialogues.text: The secret to life? It's buying houses, obviously! Everything else is just an afterthought.

dialogues.speaker: Rikas
dialogues.text: Huh? You think so? You mean to say you don't want a life like mine, where you don't have to work and can run off to Fontaine or Sumeru every few days?

dialogues.speaker: Rikas
dialogues.text: Huh? Leaving already? Suit yourself. These young people, the only way is to see for themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When you put it like that...

dialogues.speaker: Rikas
dialogues.text: See, now you're listening! Trust me, everything else is a waste of time — once you've got houses, you've got everything you need.

dialogues.speaker: Rikas
dialogues.text: I can tell just by looking at you that you're here in Nasha Town to make something of yourself! Take my advice, save up some money, and buy a house right here — the prices have a long way to rise!

dialogues.speaker: Rikas
dialogues.text: If you put your money into anything else, just be careful you don't get rinsed for everything you own. That's what's happened to most of those folks down at the square.

dialogues.speaker: Rikas
dialogues.text: Ha! You're a stubborn one! Listen good — I started buying houses back when Nasha Town was still just a little fishing village.

dialogues.speaker: Rikas
dialogues.text: Back then, I was ahead of the curve — most of the people with my sort of income spent their money on boats. The thing with boats is, they only lose value. But the houses I got back then must've jumped in price tenfold or more!

dialogues.speaker: Rikas
dialogues.text: If they could see how I'm living now, I bet the lot of them would blow their boats to smithereens! Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Rikas
dialogues.text: Oho! I'd never have guessed! Well... in that case, good for you. I bet you've got houses elsewhere, don't you? That explains your confidence...
